name: vocdoni-stripe
description: Stripe environments for Vocdoni development: the Develop, Stage and "Auditore & CI" sandboxes and live production, which backend each one feeds through its webhooks, shared Stripe CLI profile names (develop, stage, ci, live), checking the active account before any write, the agent-safe forms of the CLI's interactive commands, and running Stripe webhooks locally with `stripe listen` against saas-backend, alone or with vocdoni-app.
